title: Internal Memo: End-of-Day Cash Bag Discrepancy (Initial Administrative Notification)

sections.title: ## Header (To/From/Subject/Date)
sections.content:
**To:** Operations Manager; Finance/Accounting Lead; Security Supervisor  
**From:** Administrative Duty Officer  
**Subject:** End-of-Day Cash Bag Discrepancy — Initial Administrative Notification  
**Date:** 2026-01-02T22:20:00-05:00

sections.title: ## Purpose
sections.content: This memo documents an internally reported end-of-day cash bag discrepancy and initiates administrative preservation and review steps. This is an administrative notification only; no conclusions are made at this stage.

sections.title: ## Summary of Reported Discrepancy
sections.content: At end-of-day closeout, staff reported a mismatch between expected cash handling totals and what was located/verified in the closing cash bag. The discrepancy was identified during routine closing reconciliation. Relevant records and materials have been identified for review, including closeout documentation and related logs (see referenced evidence IDs).

sections.title: ## Known Timeline Anchors
sections.content:
- Events associated with closing activity and subsequent recognition of the discrepancy are tracked under timeline anchors **E004**, **E006**, **E007**, and **E008**.
- Administrative notification time for this memo is **2026-01-02T22:20:00-05:00**.
- Additional preservation and access audit actions are documented separately in **doc_records_preservation_002**.

sections.title: ## Immediate Administrative Actions Taken
sections.content:
- Notified management and accounting points of contact for awareness and coordination.
- Directed that relevant closeout materials and logs be preserved without alteration.
- Limited access to the affected records/materials to personnel with a business need pending review.
- Initiated a request for record access review consistent with **doc_records_preservation_002**.

sections.title: ## Requested Follow-Up / Action Items
sections.content:
- **Finance/Accounting:** Reconcile reported totals against retained closeout records (ref. **EV004**, **EV005**).
- **Security:** Verify any applicable access/control logs and retention status (ref. **EV008**).
- **Operations:** Confirm handling steps followed during closing and document any deviations (ref. **EV009**, **EV010**).
- Provide a consolidated status update to Administration within next business day.
